raw_response:
## SUBJECT OBSERVATION
Subject showed continued progression in level advancement (L5→L6) with improved scoring (42→33, still within reasonable range). However, critical gap observed: zero transmutations provided despite being at advanced level. Subject appears to be advancing through detection mechanics alone without engaging core C2A transmutation process.

Cognitive Patterns Noted:
- Strong detection capability (perfect detection record across all 7 sessions)
- Complete avoidance or inability to engage with transmutation tasks
- Consistent scarcity archetype focus without exploration of other cognitive constraint types

Strengths This Session:
- Maintained detection accuracy while advancing difficulty levels
- Showed numerical score improvement from previous session (33 vs 42)

Weaknesses This Session:
- Zero transmutation engagement (0/100 best transmutation score)
- No meta-reflection provided, suggesting limited self-awareness of cognitive processes
- No breakthrough moments despite 7 sessions of training

Recommendations for Next Session:
- Explicitly prompt for at least one transmutation attempt before allowing session completion
- Provide scaffolded transmutation examples specific to scarcity constraints
- Request mandatory meta-reflection to increase cognitive awareness

---

## PATTERN OBSERVATION
Clear plateau pattern in transmutation engagement despite level progression.

Trend Type: regression/stagnation
Evidence:
- All 7 sessions show exclusive scarcity archetype engagement (no cognitive flexibility)
- Zero transmutations across entire training history
- Detection success rate: 100% (6/6 recorded) but no growth in core skill
- Score volatility (1→44→1→32→31→42→33) without clear upward trajectory

Concern Level: high

---

## SYSTEM OBSERVATION
Critical gap in progression mechanics allowing advancement without core skill demonstration.

Component Affected: progression
Issue Type: gap
Severity: major

Proposed Change:
Implement minimum transmutation requirement for level advancement. Subject should not progress beyond L3 without demonstrating at least basic transmutation capability (minimum 20/100 transmutation score). Current system allows "gaming" through detection-only strategy.

---

## THEORETICAL OBSERVATION
Evidence suggests cognitive constraint specialization without transfer - subject has developed detection expertise in scarcity domain but shows no transfer to transmutation or other archetypes.

Cognitive Domain: transfer learning/cognitive flexibility
Hypothesis: Humans may develop narrow expertise in constraint detection without spontaneously generalizing to constraint transformation skills, even when both involve same underlying constraint concepts.
Testable Prediction: Subjects who show detection mastery in one archetype will require explicit prompting/scaffolding to engage transmutation tasks and will show minimal cross-archetype transfer without forced exposure.

---

## REFINEMENT PROPOSAL
Title: Mandatory Transmutation Gating
Description: Prevent level advancement beyond L3 without minimum transmutation score (≥20/100). Add transmutation tutorial/examples at L4 entry if none attempted in previous 3 sessions.
Rationale: Current subject demonstrates system can be "gamed" through detection alone, missing core C2A learning objective. 7 sessions with zero transmutations suggests voluntary engagement insufficient for most users.
Implementation Difficulty: medium
Expected Impact: high
How to Test: Track transmutation engagement rates before/after implementation and measure skill transfer to new archetypes post-training.
